about.title: About
about.appDescription: Nexora is a personal finance management app that helps you track income, expenses, savings goals, budgets, and financial habits in a more structured way.
about.featureTransactions: Record transactions, transfers between vaults, and your financial history with ease.
about.featureVaults: Create vaults to separate money for emergencies, travel, investments, or other goals.
about.featureBudgets: Set spending limits by category or vault to keep expenses under control.
about.featureRewards: Build a streak, earn points, and stay motivated to maintain good financial habits.
about.featureCalculator: Simulate loan payments, emergency funds, savings goals, and salary allocation with a visual breakdown.

settings.title: Settings
settings.guideDesc: Learn the basics of Nexora and find the features that fit your needs.
settings.guideStep1: Record income and expenses to understand your cash flow.
settings.guideStep2: Create vaults to separate savings and financial goals.
settings.guideStep3: Set budgets or allocation rules to stay on track.
settings.guideDashboard: Review your balance, income, expenses, and cash-flow chart.
settings.guideTransactions: Record income or expenses, choose a funding source for expenses, then search and filter your history. Schedule recurring salary, bills, or installments, then review and confirm each reminder before it is recorded.
settings.guideVaults: Organize money by goal, track balances and targets, and lock vaults you want to protect.
settings.guideBudgets: Set spending limits by category or vault. Match periods to your pay cycle and carry leftovers forward.
settings.guideAllocation: Automatically split new income across vaults by percentage, fixed amount, or remainder.
settings.guideRewards: Build a logging habit to maintain your streak, earn points, rank up, and unlock achievements.
settings.guideCalculator: Simulate loan payments, emergency funds, savings goals, and salary allocations with custom categories and a chart. Allocation is a local estimate and is not saved to your financial data.
settings.exportDesc: Download your financial history and summaries.
